description: Unique name
Name of bus to which load is attached.
Carrier of the load.
Placeholder for load type. Not implemented.
Nominal power for limits on `p` in optimization when the load is dispatched actively (i.e. `p_set` has NaN entries). Loads are never extendable.
Nominal power of the load module (fixed unit size). Introduces integer variables if set together with `committable`.
The minimum consumption for each snapshot per unit of `p_nom` for the optimization. Only relevant where `p_set` is NaN.
The maximum consumption for each snapshot per unit of `p_nom` for the optimization. Only relevant where `p_set` is NaN.

Active power consumption (positive if the load is consuming power). If NaN for a snapshot, the consumption is dispatched actively within `[p_min_pu, p_max_pu] * p_nom`; if set, it fixes the consumption (passive load).
Active power used as a starting point for limiting the ramp in the very first snapshot (for optimisation)
Reactive power consumption (positive if the load is inductive).
Sign (opposite sign to generator)
Marginal cost of consuming 1 MWh. Set negative to represent willingness-to-pay for served demand (active loads).
Quadratic marginal cost of consuming 1 MWh.
Stand-by cost incurred whenever the status is 1 (committable loads).
The minimum total energy consumed during a single optimization horizon.
The maximum total energy consumed during a single optimization horizon.
Apply unit commitment constraints. Only relevant for active loads.
Cost to start up the load. Only used if `committable=True`.
Cost to shut down the load. Only used if `committable=True`.
Minimum number of snapshots for status to be 1. Only used if `committable=True`. Does not consider snapshot weightings.
Minimum number of snapshots for status to be 0. Only used if `committable=True`. Does not consider snapshot weightings.
Number of snapshots that the load was online before `n.snapshots` start. Only used if `committable=True` and `min_up_time>0`. Does not consider snapshot weightings.
Number of snapshots that the load was offline before `n.snapshots` start. Only used if `committable=True` and `min_down_time>0`. Does not consider snapshot weightings.
Maximum active power increase from one snapshot to the next, per unit of the nominal power. Ignored if NaN. Does not consider snapshot weightings.
Maximum active power decrease from one snapshot to the next, per unit of the nominal power. Ignored if NaN. Does not consider snapshot weightings.
Maximum active power increase at start up, per unit of the nominal power. Only used if `committable=True`. Ignored if NaN.
Maximum active power decrease at shut down, per unit of the nominal power. Only used if `committable=True`. Ignored if NaN.
Active power at bus (positive if net load)
Reactive power (positive if net load)
Status in the snapshot (1 is on, 0 is off). Only returned if `committable=True`.
Whether the unit was started in the snapshot (1 is yes, 0 is no). Only returned if `committable=True`.
Whether the unit was shut down in the snapshot (1 is yes, 0 is no). Only returned if `committable=True`.
Shadow price of upper `p_nom` limit
Shadow price of lower `p_nom` limit
Shadow price of fixed power consumption `p_set`
Shadow price of upper ramp up limit
Shadow price of lower ramp down limit
Whether to consider the component in optimisation or not.
